key_findings: The $25M (Dec 2023) and $15M (Oct 2024) revenue figures, plus 32-employee count (Jul 2024), originate exclusively from Getlatka.com, an unaudited self-reported private-company revenue database.
Secondary aggregators (ZoomInfo, Tracxn, LeadIQ, CBInsights) echo these same figures but all trace back to Getlatka as the apparent single source; they do not constitute independent corroboration.
No named-author trade press article from TechInAsia, e27, DealStreetAsia, KrAsia, or Vulcan Post discloses Haulio revenue or employee headcount figures for 2023 or 2024.
The Aspire Singapore article (Feb 2025) — the most recent CEO interview found — contains no financial metrics.
The thechain.email domain hosting an Alvin Ea interview has expired and is now listed for sale; content is inaccessible.
Haulio's own blog (haulio.io) contains no revenue disclosures or employee count announcements.
ACRA BizFile for Haulio Pte Ltd financial filings requires payment and was not accessed; this remains a potential but unverified primary source.
The Series A press release (Jan 2022) notes 'significant revenue growth in 2021' but gives no figure.
The Haulio-SGTraDex/PSA integration (July 2024) announcement contains no volume or revenue metrics.
revised_claim_text: [ASSUMED-N]: Haulio revenue reportedly declined approximately 40% in 2024 ($25M Dec 2023 → $15M Oct 2024 per Getlatka unaudited estimates); employee headcount dropped from ~77 to ~32 over the same period per same source. No independent trade press or primary disclosure corroborates these figures. To validate: obtain ACRA BizFile financials for Haulio Pte Ltd, or secure direct disclosure from CEO Alvin Ea.
notes: Confirmed scarcity. All secondary aggregators (ZoomInfo, Tracxn, LeadIQ) appear to re-surface the same Getlatka data point rather than independently verifying it. The 40% revenue decline and 32-employee count should not be stated as fact in the artifact. ACRA BizFile is theoretically accessible for a fee and would be the recommended next step for a paying researcher. Score remains L.
